hazel.bio: Retired drag racer and Augie Moss's racing partner for forty years. Won the 1977 County Line Quarter on jetting alone. Distrusts laptops until she meets a VE table.

rosie.bio: Fastest pizza delivery in Kessler County. All gas, no patience. Learns racecraft, turns down a Crownwell factory seat, and drives the Cup.

dewey.bio: Farm kid who rebuilt his grandpa's tractor carb at nine. Can talk to any engine, can't talk to people. Ends up building the Tinplate Special and doing live radio.

barb.bio: Corn Belt Oil's regional rep, then Hot Dog Hut's. Speaks fluent slogan. Loyal to her racers, not her letterhead.

walt.bio: The Voice of Tinplate. Noon news, Friday sports, and every race he can drive to. Has never once lowered his voice.

victoria.bio: Owns seven car lots, the bank and the county fair's naming rights. Has been trying to buy Augie's shed for forty years. Keeps her word, eventually.

preston.bio: Victoria's son. Great hair, no friends his mother didn't hire. Gets towed out of a ditch by the people he mocked and starts building his own car.

silas.bio: The Silver Fox. Three world titles, nine years without losing a race he wanted. Polite, precise, and quietly hoping someone will finally beat him.

midge.bio: Twenty-two years as Crownwell's chief engineer. Quits when Victoria blames her for Preston's crash. Brings her own torque wrench.
